name: slides

variants.name: fullscreen
variants.description: sd-fullscreen--active — fixed inset:0 overlay, includes iOS Safari CSS-fullscreen fallback since the native Fullscreen API is unreliable there.

aria: A <details>/<summary> transcript renders alongside the deck so screen readers get the full slide text without needing the visual deck. Keyboard controller (see JS note) handles Left/Right/F/Esc navigation.
